content: API-key auth for a small FastAPI service: use FastAPI Security/APIKeyHeader with a shared dependency applied at router level (default-deny; never scatter per-route checks). Compare with hmac.compare_digest. Keep the key in an env var or local gitignored file, never in URLs, query params, bodies, logs, or CLI args (leak vectors). Keys over plaintext HTTP on a LAN are sniffable - if binding beyond loopback, require TLS or accept the risk knowingly. Note CVE-2026-23996: even key verification can leak via timing side channels on exposed services.
